records.TEST_SYSTEM_NAME: Ortho-Clinical Diagnostics VITROS 5600/ XT7600 Integrated System {BRAHMS PCT}

tsh_on_xt7600: No FDA CLIA record names the XT 7600 for TSH. TSH records exist for VITROS 5600 (K081543, 10/28/2008), VITROS 3600 (K083173), VITROS ECiQ (K962919), VITROS ECi (K964558), all MODERATE. Per BUG-009 rules (FDA records only, nothing inferred) TSH is not added to the XT 7600 library menu; a lab running it adds it on its own map.
